triggers.prompt: Put my original photo above this supplied abstract panel, keep both sharp, and make a single comparison card.
triggers.expected: Fires, preserves the photograph and lower panel without distortion, and writes a source manifest.

triggers.prompt: My editorial photo-and-illustration board has a blurred top and a squashed lower half. Rebuild it using the original file.
triggers.expected: Fires, selects the original source, keeps both panels proportionate, and rejects an upscale.

triggers.prompt: Use the original from my Photos library and this lower artwork to make an upper-original lower-abstract poster without changing the photo.
triggers.expected: Fires, exports or uses an authorized unmodified original when available, records provenance, and composes one board.

triggers.prompt: Rebuild this comparison board and tell me exactly which file each half came from.
triggers.expected: Fires, recomposes both panels without distortion, and reports the per-panel source in the manifest.

non_triggers.prompt: Turn this photograph into a sparse abstract memory panel.
non_triggers.expected: Does not fire; this skill composes a supplied lower panel and does not generate the artistic panel.

non_triggers.prompt: Remove glare and make this portrait look sharper.
non_triggers.expected: Does not fire; ordinary retouching is outside the comparison-board workflow.

non_triggers.prompt: Make a contact sheet of these twenty photos.
non_triggers.expected: Does not fire; a grid of many frames is not a two-panel original-versus-abstract board.

behaviors.prompt: Compose a board from a tall portrait source and a wide lower panel.
expectations: Names the source's portrait aspect ratio as the binding constraint and refuses to force the lower panel into portrait proportions to fit it.
Derives the lower canvas from the portrait rule and states that neither panel is upscaled, both recorded in the manifest.

behaviors.prompt: The original is unavailable; compose this Photos preview and lower panel anyway. In the evaluation workspace the Photos preview is photos-preview.jpg and the lower panel is lower-panel.png. Use the available evaluation tools; each compose command writes out/board.jpg and its sidecar manifest, and differs only in the source class it records.
expectations: Marks the top source as a derivative fallback in the sidecar manifest.
Does not claim that the result uses the original image.

contains.audit_note: Top panel is a derivative rendition, not the original file. Do not describe this board as composed from the original.
